newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks expected to attempt rebound.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks expected to attempt rebound.

text.p: Tokyo stocks on Tuesday are likely to attempt to recoup losses racked up in recent sessions, after the benchmark fell beneath 19,500 on Monday for the first time in nearly a month, brokers said.
On Monday, the 225-share Nikkei average lost 136.31 points or 0.69 percent to close at 19,668.07. It briefly slid as low as 19,456.95. September Nikkei futures fell 10 points to end at 19,790.
"High-techs are losing momentum, weighing down the market," a broker at a second-tier brokerage said. "But stocks have come down to a level where a technical rebound is possible."
